accept_bayesian_sequence-video.title: Bayesian sampling across lots — colleague preview
accept_bayesian_sequence-video.note: Initial preview for colleague feedback. Repaired-build preview at revision 9d08972b6b10b8d04b9650ecce4b1560f811b629 uses all 12 chronological lots with no predictors. Three chains, 2000 warmup, 5000 retained draws per chain, thin 1, seed 1; Adapt Delta .99 resolves one rehearsal divergence at .97. Zero divergences/treedepth hits, maximum rank-normalized R-hat 1.001, minimum bulk/tail ESS 5597/4285, E-BFMI .959/.922/.957. The trajectory is retrospective smoothing, with latest rate about 7.81% and 95% interval [4.38%,12.70%]. Prediction is 9 + Binomial(900,theta), support 9–909; the grouped central-range plot is not the full support. No acceptance-policy claim or prior-sensitivity validation is made.
